# Formalization metadata schema

`schema/v0.4.schema.json` is copied without modification from
[mathlib-initiative/formalization.yaml](https://github.com/mathlib-initiative/formalization.yaml),
revision `99c678e569c7c4c0772db297c5ddd5e4c9b6322e`, checked on 2026-10-08.
Its upstream Apache-2.0 license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

This is a reproducible schema snapshot. The local preflight also checks the
submission constraints reviewed at PalomarSubmission revision
`d4e41c1d5b0d114c4859e6e5831dc6d3ad1d0d44` and PalomarPolicy revision
`96b034cc31a72a63d4f4041911dce337a85c9a04`. Later submissions should compare
these snapshots with the current policy.

The local preflight recognizes the classification codes selected by this
project; it does not redistribute the complete MSC taxonomy or claim to
validate arbitrary classification codes.
